title: Check the domain
text: Before solving, identify any domain restrictions. The denominator cannot be zero, so we know that $$x-2$$ $$\neq$$ $$0$$, which means $$x\neq$$ $$2$$.

title: Analyze the structure
text: Notice that both sides of the equation are fractions with the exact same denominator: $$(x-2).$$

title: Equate the numerators
text: If two fractions have the same denominator, their values can only be equal if their numerators are equal. Therefore, we can simply set the numerators equal to each other: $$x+2=4$$.

title: Conclusion
text: We found that $$x=2$$, but our initial domain restriction stated that $$x\neq$$ $$2$$ because it makes the denominator zero. Since our only possible solution is invalid, there are no solutions.
